#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

int main() {
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    ll a, b, ta;
    double min_ratio = 214748364.0, t;

    for (ll tb = 1; tb <= n; ++tb) {
        ta = (tb * x) / y;
        t = abs(tb * x - ta * y) / (double)(y * (tb + 0.0));
        if (t < min_ratio) {
            a = ta;
            b = tb;
            min_ratio = t;
        }
        ta++;
        t = abs(tb * x - ta * y) / (double)(y * (tb + 0.0));
        if (t < min_ratio) {
            a = ta;
            b = tb;
            min_ratio = t;
        }
    }

    ll limit = (ll)sqrt(max(a, b));
    for (ll i = 2; i < limit; ++i) {
        while (a % i == 0 && b % i == 0) {
            a /= i;
            b /= i;
        }
    }

    cout << a << '/' << b << endl;
    return 0;
}
